_doc: Draft content for design chapter 39 (docs/design/39-deeper-trees-boost-stations.md). Assumes doc 37 section 7.1 (T154-T159, T170-T182, renames of T140 and T142) is merged first. "add" entries use the content/technologies.json fields at top level; the "draft" object holds what goes to content/pacing.json nodes (tier, tags, era via pacing_era for antiquity) and the new per-node fields of chapter 39 section 1 (era, kind, evidence source, family, work_bp, hint_bp, fragile, needs_facility); name_zh goes to apps/web/scripts/i18n-data-tech.mjs. lore "needed": every new node needs an encyclopedia passage in content/lore/technologies.json before the content is merged. Existing ids are unchanged; new ids continue from T183; no new node is a prerequisite of the victory-critical set.
